description: This is a test class for the EmployeeLicenseDao in the OrangeHRM project, containing unit tests for CRUD operations, search, and license allowance retrieval related to employee licenses.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class verifying the functionalities of EmployeeLicenseDao including retrieval, deletion, search, and permission-based license fetching.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating EmployeeLicenseDao and populating test data from fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific employee license by employee and license IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified employee licenses.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Verifies searching employee licenses by employee number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests adding a new employee license.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests editing and updating an existing license.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Checks counts for licenses matching search criteria.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Tests fetching of licenses allowed for specific employees, including permission filtering.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Verifies count of allowed licenses per employee for permission checks.
